# DSB Medical

> Changzhou DSB Medical — Chinese manufacturer and supplier of incontinence-care and drug-delivery devices. OEM/ODM/CDMO.

- [Home](https://en.dsbmedical.com/): DSB Medical official homepage
- [Products](https://en.dsbmedical.com/products.html): Products and services overview

## Core Products

- [Male External Catheter](https://en.dsbmedical.com/male-external-catheter-manufacturer-china.html): Condom catheter / male urinary sheath manufacturer and supplier China.
- [Male External Catheter detail](https://en.dsbmedical.com/pro_detail/73.html): 100% medical-grade silicone, latex-free condom catheter; 25/29/32 mm; OEM/ODM; Didun brand.
- [Fecal Management System](https://en.dsbmedical.com/pro_detail/76.html): Fecal management system for incontinence and critical care.
- [SMI Soft Mist Inhaler](https://en.dsbmedical.com/pro_detail/84.html): Soft mist inhaler device CDMO / OEM/ODM.
- [DPI Dry Powder Inhaler](https://en.dsbmedical.com/pro_detail/83.html): Dry powder inhaler platform for respiratory drug delivery.
- [pMDI](https://en.dsbmedical.com/pro_detail/85.html): Pressurized metered-dose inhaler for respiratory therapy.
- [Mesh Nebulizer](https://en.dsbmedical.com/pro_detail/86.html): Vibration mesh nebulizer platform for hospital and home use.
- [FluidMS®](https://en.dsbmedical.com/fluidms.html): Fluid management system, EU MDR CE Class IIa.
- [SorafreeCX](https://www.dsbmedical.com/sorafree.html): AI-driven incontinence and critical-care nursing system; not a pharmaceutical, unrelated to sorafenib.

## Solutions

- [Drug Delivery](https://en.dsbmedical.com/drug-delivery.html): Auto-injectors and drug-delivery systems
- [Inhalation Devices](https://en.dsbmedical.com/inhalation.html): Inhalation and nebulizer devices
- [FreeHala™](https://en.dsbmedical.com/freehala.html): Drug-device combination inhalation platform (SMI/DPI/pMDI)
- [DXneb™](https://en.dsbmedical.com/dxneb.html): Piezoelectric vibration mesh nebulizer
- [Goldhaler®](https://en.dsbmedical.com/goldhaler.html): Neonatal RDS / pressurized metered-dose inhaler brand
- [Didun®](https://en.dsbmedical.com/didun.html): DSB incontinence-care brand
- [Urine Bag](https://en.dsbmedical.com/urine-bag.html): Urine collection bags and accessories
- [Incontinence Care](https://en.dsbmedical.com/Incontinence.html): Adult incontinence care products
- [Medical Consumables](https://en.dsbmedical.com/Consumables.html): Comprehensive medical consumables
